_comment: Tier-2 for sparta surface_interaction: 'compute grid'/'compute surf' always produce ARRAYS (bare c_ID is never valid), and the column count is ngroup*nvalue where ngroup is 1 for the built-in 'all' mixture, for a mixture defined without 'group', AND for one defined with 'group <name>'. Only 'group SELF' or the built-in 'species' mixture give per-species columns. A fix ave/* fed ONE value is the opposite: a VECTOR read bare as f_ID.
